BD Platform 

Command Your Security Operations 

Gain complete visibility and control across your detection, investigation, and response workflows. BD Platform combines AI augmentation, telemetry integration, and practitioner insight to accelerate outcomes by improving detection quality, reducing response times, and advancing operational maturity. 

What Is BD Platform?

Unify Security Operations 

BD Platform connects every part of your managed security services, including MDR, threat hunting, digital risk protection, and co-managed tools. With real-time access to investigations, alerts, and service data, your team gains a single view of what’s happening, what’s been done, and what’s next. 

Operate faster, prove impact, and stay one step ahead. 

Capabilities by Plane 

BD Platform is the platform that powers every Binary Defense service—from MDR to Threat Hunting. Built on a foundation of the attackers-mindset, AI insights, analyst expertise, and automation, BD Platform streamlines detection, containment, and response across every layer of your security program. 

01 

Detection Plane 

Focus on Real Threats, Not Noise 

Our Detection Plane ingests telemetry from across your environment—endpoint, identity, network, cloud—and enriches it with threat intelligence and detection logic. 

02 

Automation Plane 

Scale decision-making without sacrificing insight. 

Automation handles alert routing, triage enrichment, and orchestration so analysts spend less time sorting signals and more time stopping threats. 

03 

Response Plane 

Contain threats before they spread. 

BD Platform enables fast, coordinated response across endpoint, identity, and cloud through human-guided actions or automated containment. 

04 

Visibility Plane 

See more. Understand faster. 

Connect the dots between raw telemetry, detection outcomes, and incident trends—giving security teams deeper insights and better reporting. 

Designed Around Your Team, Not Ours

Built for the Way You Work 

BD Platform integrates with the tools, roles, and workflows you already rely on. Whether you’re tuning detections, reviewing incidents, or reporting to leadership, the platform delivers transparency and control without disrupting your rhythm. 

Collaboration with analysts and engineers inside the platform 
Role-based dashboards for analysts, managers, and executives 
Support for the tools you have and the telemetry you want 
Real-time visibility into every ticket, hunt, and containment action 

AI from the Attackers-Mindset 

AI Augmented 

Behind every alert is a judgment call and we’ve built a system that learns to make smarter ones. Our AI continuously evolves by analyzing alarm data, incorporating analyst feedback, and learning from response actions in real time. It doesn’t just surface threats; it ranks them by confidence, context, and urgency to reduce noise, improve triage accuracy, and help your team focus faster. With each response, it gets sharper, closing the loop between machine learning and human expertise to drive higher-fidelity detection, faster decisions, and measurable operational gains. 

Precision Logic. Less Noise. More Signal. 

Detect 

BD Platform surfaces only what matters. With threat-informed detection engineering, ai-augmented logic, and contextual enrichment, alerts are more accurate, actionable, and aligned to your environment.

Disrupt & Contain 

BD Platform enables containment at the speed of operations, whether through analyst-guided decisions or automated playbooks. Get cross-platform visibility, you can take decisive action across endpoints, identity, and cloud. 

Get to Root Cause, Not Just the Alert. 

Investigate 

Investigations go beyond basic triage. Analysts reconstruct timelines, correlate telemetry, and validate threats with real human expertise. You get clarity, not escalation. 

Coordinated. Documented. Complete. 

Respond 

From initial alert to forensic analysis, connect every action in the response lifecycle. You gain full visibility into what happened, how it was stopped, and what’s next without chasing down disconnected data. 

Take Back Control of Your Security Operations

Ready to See What’s Possible? 

BD Platform brings clarity, confidence, and speed to your security program. Whether you're improving detection, shortening response, or proving value to leadership, it gives you the visibility and control to lead from the front.
